TRUNCATE TABLE BUSC.LNS_LADMDHISTORY_DELTA;

WITH SRC AS
(	SELECT 
	HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT([ACID],[ASSOCIATION_ID],[BANK_ID],[CRYSTALLISED_AMT],[DEL_FLG],[DEMAND_IND],[DMD_AMT],[DMD_DATE],[DMD_EFF_DATE],[DMD_FLOW_ID],[DMD_OVDU_DATE],[DMD_SRL_NUM],[EI_AMT],[FEE_TYPE],[LAST_ADJ_DATE],[LAST_WAIVER_ADJ_DATE],[LATEFEE_STATUS_FLG],[LCHG_TIME],[LCHG_USER_ID],[LDT_CRNCY_CODE],[LD_FREQ_TYPE],[RCRE_TIME],[RCRE_USER_ID],[SHDL_NUM],[TOT_ADJ_AMT],[TOT_INST_ADJ_AMT],[TS_CNT],[WAIVED_AMT])) AS HASHROW,
	 ACID,BANK_ID,DEL_FLG,DMD_DATE,DMD_FLOW_ID,DMD_SRL_NUM,SHDL_NUM
	FROM (
		SELECT 
         ACID
        ,ASSOCIATION_ID
        ,BANK_ID
        ,convert(numeric(22,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRYSTALLISED_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) as CRYSTALLISED_AMT
        ,DEL_FLG
        ,DEMAND_IND
        ,convert(numeric(22,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([DMD_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) as DMD_AMT
        ,CONVERT(DATE,[DMD_DATE]) AS DMD_DATE
        ,convert(date,[DMD_EFF_DATE]) AS DMD_EFF_DATE,DMD_FLOW_ID
        ,convert(date,[DMD_OVDU_DATE]) AS DMD_OVDU_DATE,DMD_SRL_NUM
        ,convert(numeric(22,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([EI_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) as EI_AMT
        ,FEE_TYPE
        ,convert(date,[LAST_ADJ_DATE]) AS LAST_ADJ_DATE
        ,convert(date,[LAST_WAIVER_ADJ_DATE]) AS LAST_WAIVER_ADJ_DATE
        ,LATEFEE_STATUS_FLG,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(LCHG_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as LCHG_TIME
        ,LCHG_USER_ID,LDT_CRNCY_CODE,LD_FREQ_TYPE,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(RCRE_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as RCRE_TIME
        ,RCRE_USER_ID,SHDL_NUM,convert(numeric(22,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([TOT_ADJ_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) as TOT_ADJ_AMT
        ,convert(numeric(22,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([TOT_INST_ADJ_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) as TOT_INST_ADJ_AMT
        ,convert(numeric(22,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([TS_CNT],' ',''),''),0)) as TS_CNT
        ,convert(numeric(22,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([WAIVED_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) as WAIVED_AMT
        ,1 AS isActive
        ,1 AS isLatest
        ,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
        ,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
        ,[FILE_NAME]
        ,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
        FROM [d360].[stg_lns_LADMDHISTORY]
        WHERE H = 'D'
)A ), 
TGT AS 
(	SELECT 
	HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT( [ACID],[ASSOCIATION_ID],[BANK_ID],[CRYSTALLISED_AMT],[DEL_FLG],[DEMAND_IND],[DMD_AMT],[DMD_DATE],[DMD_EFF_DATE],[DMD_FLOW_ID],[DMD_OVDU_DATE],[DMD_SRL_NUM],[EI_AMT],[FEE_TYPE],[LAST_ADJ_DATE],[LAST_WAIVER_ADJ_DATE],[LATEFEE_STATUS_FLG],[LCHG_TIME],[LCHG_USER_ID],[LDT_CRNCY_CODE],[LD_FREQ_TYPE],[RCRE_TIME],[RCRE_USER_ID],[SHDL_NUM],[TOT_ADJ_AMT],[TOT_INST_ADJ_AMT],[TS_CNT],[WAIVED_AMT])) AS HASHROW,
    ACID,BANK_ID,DEL_FLG,DMD_DATE,DMD_FLOW_ID,DMD_SRL_NUM,SHDL_NUM
	FROM BUSC.LNS_LADMDHISTORY
	WHERE	isLatest = 1 
	
)

INSERT INTO BUSC.LNS_LADMDHISTORY_DELTA
(SRC_HR,TGT_HR,ACID,BANK_ID,DMD_DATE,DMD_FLOW_ID,DMD_SRL_NUM,SHDL_NUM,DEL_FLG,ISACTIVE,ISLATEST,RECORD_STATUS)
SELECT
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR                                       
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.ACID,TGT.ACID) AS ACID
	,ISNULL(SRC.BANK_ID,TGT.BANK_ID) AS BANK_ID
	,ISNULL(SRC.DMD_DATE,TGT.DMD_DATE) AS DMD_DATE
	,ISNULL(SRC.DMD_FLOW_ID,TGT.DMD_FLOW_ID) AS DMD_FLOW_ID
	,ISNULL(SRC.DMD_SRL_NUM,TGT.DMD_SRL_NUM) AS DMD_SRL_NUM
	,ISNULL(SRC.SHDL_NUM,TGT.SHDL_NUM) AS SHDL_NUM
    ,ISNULL(SRC.DEL_FLG,TGT.DEL_FLG) AS DEL_FLG
	,CASE WHEN 
		(SRC.ACID IS NULL
		AND SRC.DMD_DATE IS NULL
		AND SRC.DMD_FLOW_ID IS NULL
		AND SRC.DMD_SRL_NUM IS NULL
		AND SRC.SHDL_NUM IS NULL
		AND SRC.BANK_ID IS NULL) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isActive
	,CASE WHEN 
		(SRC.ACID IS NULL
		AND SRC.DMD_DATE IS NULL
		AND SRC.DMD_FLOW_ID IS NULL
		AND SRC.DMD_SRL_NUM IS NULL
		AND SRC.SHDL_NUM IS NULL
		AND SRC.BANK_ID IS NULL) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isLatest
	,CASE 
		WHEN SRC.DEL_FLG = 'Y' THEN 'DELETE'
		WHEN
			(TGT.ACID IS NULL
			AND TGT.DMD_DATE IS NULL
			AND TGT.DMD_FLOW_ID IS NULL
			AND TGT.DMD_SRL_NUM IS NULL
			AND TGT.SHDL_NUM IS NULL
			AND TGT.BANK_ID IS NULL) THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW != TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE' ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
FROM SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TGT
	ON SRC.ACID = TGT.ACID 
	AND SRC.DMD_DATE = TGT.DMD_DATE 
	AND SRC.DMD_FLOW_ID = TGT.DMD_FLOW_ID 
	AND SRC.DMD_SRL_NUM = TGT.DMD_SRL_NUM 
	AND SRC.SHDL_NUM = TGT.SHDL_NUM 
	AND SRC.BANK_ID = TGT.BANK_ID
WHERE (SRC.ACID IS NULL OR TGT.ACID IS NULL
	OR SRC.DMD_DATE IS NULL OR TGT.DMD_DATE IS NULL
	OR SRC.DMD_FLOW_ID IS NULL OR TGT.DMD_FLOW_ID IS NULL 
	OR SRC.DMD_SRL_NUM IS NULL OR TGT.DMD_SRL_NUM IS NULL
	OR SRC.SHDL_NUM IS NULL OR TGT.SHDL_NUM IS NULL
	OR SRC.BANK_ID IS NULL OR TGT.BANK_ID IS NULL
) OR SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
